'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ian Campbell DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ian Campbell]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

* '''Deck name:''' Boars & Hoes
* '''Username:''' Runner
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
